assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Landscape 16:9 concept painting for Depths, a dark gritty medieval first-person cave crawler. Bird's-eye three-quarter view of a SMALL UNDERGROUND REFUGE on a broad defensible rocky ledge above an immense cavern containing a DISTANT crude goblin fortress. The foreground ledge is a believable connected place: a modest unlit sleeping shelter built against rock, a small warm campfire circle with empty sitting stones, battered supply crates and a recognisable stash chest grouped near the shelter, one rough survey table. Uneven trampled paths connect these sites organically across continuous ground. A readable narrow trail enters from the upper-left mine tunnel and a different rope-lined path descends along the right cliff toward the far goblin territory. Clear foreground ledge edge, quiet midground targets, distant fortress silhouettes and tiny hostile lights for scale. Hand-painted dark fantasy, rough carved shapes, irregular stone, patched canvas, damp soot-dark umber/slate, restrained warm refuge light against cold cavern distance. Weathered and humanly imperfect, not polished or symmetrical. No people, named NPCs, vendors, active combat, labels, text, UI, floating buttons, logos, faction emblems or magical healing. No ceiling sky or daylight. Provide a composition study, not separated production layers; enough calm space between targets for landscape phone readability.

Use case: stylized-concept. Full-screen 16:9 atmospheric vision still for Depths, a dark gritty cave crawler. A vast sleeping presence FELT THROUGH ROCK, almost entirely withheld: rough black slate ribs of the earth recede into blue-black darkness, an immense slow organic fold curves through a distant fissure, a faint cold mineral reflection suggests a heartbeat deep below. Abstract spatial dread and impossible scale, felt more than seen. No defined face, eye, teeth, limbs, heart anatomy, egg, organs or identifiable final monster. No paired rounded masses. A single broad folded geological/organic curve disappearing past the frame. Restrained dark fantasy painted illustration with substantial irregular material shapes and sparse readable details; no photoreal noise. Neutral desaturated slate/charcoal with a very restrained cold blue undertone; the game adds its own blue vision filter, so do not flood the painting in saturated cyan. Low contrast foreground, a quiet distant focal seam. No people, text, UI, border, symbols, religious marks, lettering, gore or magic beam. A threatening dream impression suitable behind dialogue; reserve lower left and lower fifth as quiet dark shapes.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE isolated empty glass potion vessel for a modular 64x64 inventory icon in Depths, dark gritty medieval fantasy. Front-facing UPRIGHT SQUAT ROUND BOTTLE, short narrow central neck and broad low round belly, flat stable base, plain broad brown cork at top. Whole vessel centered with ample transparent padding. Thick weathered neutral smoky-clear glass, readable chunky pale-grey edge facets, some uneven hand-blown thickness, tiny surface scuffs, simple dark cork. EMPTY neutral interior: no liquid, tint, label, wax seal, stamp, markings or magical glow. Preserve clear interior as transparent or translucent glass so a separate liquid-colour layer can be applied; strongest glass detail belongs to outline and rim. Restrained painted pixel-art, broad clusters, crisp stepped silhouette, muted charcoal/grey/dirty ivory and cork umber, not glossy product photography or smooth vector. No hands, people, props, cast shadow, floor, text, frame or checkerboard. Genuine transparent background. Centre the cork on the top vertical axis; no tilted vessel.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE 2:1 wide environmental inset for Depths first-person dungeon crawler. A low rough black-slate WALKWAY LIP across the bottom quarter, and an immense opaque deep black water surface extending into a dim cistern beyond it. View looking slightly DOWN off the edge, readable vertical drop between narrow foreground stone coping and water several metres below. Faint broad reflections from an unseen vaulted wall, sparse flat ripples, far wall barely sensed in darkness. No stairs, doors, bodies, creatures, lights, people, glowing waves, text or UI. Restrained painted pixel art and broad irregular shapes suitable for native256x128 world display. Palette cold soot charcoal/slate with a little mineral umber, no saturated blue. Entire image opaque: black water must occlude geometry behind, no transparent hole. Architectural depth cue, not a photograph or a walkable floor texture.

Use case: stylized-concept. One front-facing complete architectural PROP CUTOUT for Depths first-person grid cave crawler, native192x192. WET BLACK STONE STEPS descending away and downward into an opaque dark stairwell opening, framed by a broken-edged low slate threshold and two modest rough stone cheeks. Broad shallow near tread, progressively narrower steps receding into darkness, uneven hand-cut eroded edges and silt in corners. Intact route, no collapsing treads. Entire surrounding silhouette visible with padding, no extra floor plane beyond threshold. The dark internal aperture MUST remain opaque to hide the room beyond; only OUTSIDE the stone assembly genuinely transparent. Coarse restrained painted pixel-art clusters, muted cold charcoal/grey and mineral brown, neutral diffuse shading, subtle damp surfaces not glossy mirrors. No flowing water, torches, light glow, closed gate, rails, characters, lettering, UI or frame. A square front view for mounting in a 2-metre dungeon wall, no isometric side angle.

Use case: stylized-concept. A landscape 16:9 story illustration for Depths, a dark gritty medieval cave crawler, for a 640x360 ending card or conversation background. Grounded hand-painted dark fantasy with broad readable shapes, worn irregular stone, restrained earthy charcoal/slate/umber, cold damp darkness and sparse meaningful warm accents. Avoid pristine symmetry, glossy perfect masonry, microscopic noise and oversaturated colour. Full opaque scene, no frame, text, lettering, UI, symbols, logos or named characters. Quiet dark shapes in lower fifth and lower-left for dialogue/portrait placement. Subject: the BLACK RESERVOIR drained low, a vast subterranean cistern with uneven stone walkways and silted terraces now exposed. Far below the foreground walkway, beyond the last dark water, a SINGLE immense broad sleeping curve disappears beneath ancient rock. It is barely distinguishable from folded geology: suggest unbelievable scale without exposing a whole being, face, eye, limbs or anatomy. A narrow newly exposed stair threads down from the foreground into the unknown, visibly tiny against the distant curve. Architecture and waterlines establish depth. No paired rounded masses, corpses, gore, battle, magical glow or final-boss reveal. A restrained story-end glimpse of a route continuing downward.
